<p><b>Note</b>: As mentioned in the Registration Guidelines, you need to do the following steps:</>

 <h1 style="color: #333;">World Youth Festival 2024</h1>
    <p style="margin-bottom: 10px; color: #555;">The World Youth Festival provides both <strong style="color: #1389FD;">Fully Funded</strong> and <strong style="color: #1389FD;">Self-Funded</strong> Opportunities. To qualify for <strong style="color: #1389FD;">Full Funding</strong>, delegates must complete all registration steps and fulfill payment by the specified deadline. If not selected for Full Funding, delegates can still participate through a self-funded scheme.</p>
    <p style="margin-bottom: 10px; color: #555;">The comprehensive expenses outlined in the World Youth Festival payment cover accommodation throughout the program (<strong style="color: #1389FD;">October 5 - 8, 2024</strong>), including airport transfers on the first day (<strong style="color: #1389FD;">October 5, 2024</strong>, for transfer from the airport to the hotel) and the last day of the program (<strong style="color: #1389FD;">October 8, 2024</strong>, for transfer from the hotel to the airport). It's crucial to note that all fully funded or self-funded payments do not cover flight tickets and visa expenses. The fully-funded spots will be allocated based on the registrants' quality.</p>
    <p style="margin-bottom: 20px; color: #555;">With a delegate quota limited to only <strong style="color: #1389FD;">200 youth</strong>, let's join hands and collaborate at the World Youth Festival 2024. <p>The World Youth Festival (WYF), orchestrated by the <em>Youth Break the Boundaries (YBB) Foundation</em>, This platform is designed to cultivate the spirit of entrepreneurship, encourage collaboration, and foster the contribution of youth globally, Additionally, it aims to ensure the readiness of the next generation to tackle the challenges of the future.

The dynamic platform serves as a global hub for young visionaries, where innovative ideas converge to shape a brighter tomorrow. The festival also provides a unique opportunity for young leaders from diverse backgrounds to connect, exchange ideas, and collaborate on projects that benefit society. Through interactive workshops, insightful discussions, and networking sessions, participants gain valuable skills and insights to drive positive change in their communities and beyond. Together, participants embark on a transformative journey towards a more sustainable and inclusive future.
</p>

$value[0]['testimony']
I'm very happy to be at this event today, hosted by the YBB organization. I'm truly inspired and energized by the spirit of the participants, the youth. I hope we can cross paths in the future and work together with YBB to organize more events.

The participants, students from high school or university, are all engaged in the sessions. They need to focus millions on their ideas, study hard, and invest their skills in serving the community. I appreciate their values and principles. I think students have a lot of opportunities and privileges to contribute more, do more, and benefit from coaching, mentoring, and guidance to choose courses, programs, and identify their best paths throughout their lives.

The best way for all changemakers is to have role models. As Muslims, we have the greatest role model, Prophet Muhammad SAW. I think changemakers should affiliate with organizations, teams, unions, and be part of their change movements. This way, they can make a better change, be incubated to develop their potentials, and achieve their goals. Nowadays, I'm more aware of the opportunities for individuals in innovation and success. We need to work as a team and look for opportunities together to achieve our goals. This requires us to work together. As students, we need to identify our strengths and build on those potentials, receive guidance and coaching, and continue learning.

WYF is part of YBB's unique program, bringing together many youth from different parts of the world. They cross boundaries, cultures, religions, and colors. I think this is very important because our globe and universe are one. We need to come together from different parts of the world, discuss common issues, share interests, address similar challenges, and come up with common solutions from different ideas. I advocate for continuing and bringing more students from different countries.
